data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 Property results benefited from a lack of major loss events during the calendar year, as well as favourable loss development which resulted in releases from prior year reserves. US Casualty business has faced difficult market conditions for some time as loss experience has been relatively benign in recent years. The book continues to perform very well and it has been possible again to release reserves from prior years.
